nimble.claim: Rippling announced via Business Wire on 2026-09-21 that it is opening an AI lab in Bengaluru, India ('Rippling Opens AI Lab in Bengaluru to Accelerate the Future of AI-Powered Business Software').

Rippling updated its Automated Compliance product on 2026-09-22 to support multi-framework audit programs (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA templates), broader third-party integrations, a built-in audit portal, publishable trust centers, and embedded AI workflows for framework setup, remediation, and security questionnaires.

Rippling introduced new Rippling AI capabilities on 2026-09-23 (plugins, skills, and automations) giving employees AI with context on their role, team, and policies, reusable prompts, and automation of recurring work, governed by existing Rippling permissions and the MCP Gateway.

Rippling announced on 2026-10-08 (Business Wire) the expansion of its New York City office to 132,693 sq ft near Penn Station; CoStar reported on Oct 9 and Rippling LinkedIn posts confirmed the new NYC office opened that week.

exa.claim: On 2026-09-22, Rippling launched a research and engineering AI Lab at its Bengaluru campus, expanded workspace to 170,000 sq. ft., and said it was hiring across AI research, applied AI, backend, platform engineering, and machine learning.

On 2026-09-23, Rippling launched new Rippling AI capabilities (plugins, skills, and automations) that connect approved third-party systems, package reusable instructions, and run AI workflows automatically under existing permissions and policies.
On 2026-10-08, Rippling opened a 132,693-square-foot office at 330 West 34th Street in New York City to support more than 1,000 employees, nearly doubling its previous New York footprint.
On 2026-10-13, Rippling expanded its Preferred Carrier Program as Principal, Beam Benefits, and Sun Life joined, bringing the total to six preferred carriers with deeper benefits integrations.

On 2026-10-15, Rippling reintroduced Automated Compliance with multi-framework support, broader integrations, automated evidence collection and remediation, a built-in audit portal, publishable trust centers, and embedded AI workflows.
On 2026-10-20, Rippling promoted Neel Murthy from Vice President of Growth to Chief Marketing Officer.
